description_en: Queries the list of topics under a specified data source in the rules engine by paging
description_zh: 调用该接口分页查询规则引擎中指定数据源下的Topic列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-data-source-item --iot-instance-id iot-0pp1n8t000 --page-size 10 --data-source-id 1001 --page 1 --search-name thing --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataSourceItem

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the **ID** is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，取值范围为1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The data source ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432676.html operation to view all data source IDs of the current instance
parameters.help_zh:
数据源ID。

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432676.html接口，可查看当前实例下所有数据源ID
parameters.name: data_source_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，取值范围为1~100,000
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: A string segment of a topic value. Topics that match this string are returned
parameters.help_zh: 传入Topic值中任意一段字符串，根据该字符串检索能匹配的Topic
parameters.name: search_name
